title: Learning Dynamics of On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2611.08016v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) is emerging as an important paradigm for language-model post-training, combining dense teacher supervision with training on student-generated trajectories. This creates a feedback loop where each update changes the student and thereby the training distribution that generates subsequent updates. Yet, how this feedback shapes learning and generalization remains poorly understood. We conduct a mechanistic analysis of OPD's learning dynamics, distinguishing the two feedback loop stages: conversion of the distillation signal into parameter updates, and broadcast through which these updates change predictions across prefixes and reshape the rollout distribution. translated_title: 在策略蒸馏的学习动力学
translated_abstract: 在策略蒸馏（OPD）正在成为语言模型后训练的一种重要范式，它将密集的教师监督与基于学生模型自身生成轨迹的训练相结合。这形成了一个反馈循环：每一次参数更新都会改变学生模型，进而改变生成后续更新的训练分布。然而，这种反馈如何塑造学习与泛化，目前仍知之甚少。我们对OPD的学习动力学进行了机制分析，区分了反馈循环的两个阶段：其一是蒸馏信号向参数更新的转换，其二是“广播”——通过广播，这些更新改变跨前缀的预测并重塑采样分布。这一框架有助于我们理解两种现象：一是尽管师生模型之间存在显著分歧，学生模型的响应却有限；二是当那些能够提升局部教师一致性的更新同时也增加了不成功续写出现的概率时，会发生模型退化。
tldr: 本文对在策略蒸馏的学习动力学进行了机制分析，提出将反馈循环分解为“蒸馏信号转换”与“广播”两个阶段的框架，用以解释学生响应有限以及训练过程中的退化现象。
en_tdlr: This paper provides a mechanistic analysis of on-policy distillation's learning dynamics, proposing a framework that decomposes the feedback loop into two stages—distillation signal conversion and broadcast—to explain limited student responsiveness and training degeneration.
